title: The Last of the Red Dye

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Before a festival, a dyer realizes they have the only good batch of red dye left, and several families are hoping for some.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Before a festival, (name1), a dyer, realizes they have the only good batch of red dye left, and several families are hoping for some.

choices.label: Use It for One Shared Banner.
Teach Others How to Make It.
Keep It for Those Who Asked First.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Every family gets a little, and the festival is bright with red.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The small amounts are barely enough, but everyone is pleased.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The banner becomes the centerpiece of the festival.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some families wanted their own red, but they come to admire the banner.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Several villagers make their own batches in time.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The new batches turn orange, which everyone decides is just as festive.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The first families are delighted, and the others try other colors.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The others feel left out, and the dyer promises them first choice next time.
